notes: Power dissipation stated as < 1W (no exact W value). Rate selectable via RS0: LOW 1.25 Gb/s (1000BASE-LX), HIGH 9.95–10.3 Gb/s typ (10GBASE-LR/LW); features also cite 9.95 to 10.5 Gb/s. Limiting receiver (not EDC). Rx sensitivity -19 dBm (1G, BER<10^-12); -12.6 dBm OMA @ 10.3 Gb/s; stressed -14.4 dBm (1G) and -10.3 dBm OMA @ 10.3 Gb/s. Transmitter and Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 3.2 dB (10G) without paired penalty-point conditions. Section V table labels LOS Assert as LOSD (-17 dBm) and LOS Hysteresis row uses LOSA (-30 dBm); Section IV uses LOS De-Assert LOSD -17 dBm and LOS Assert LOSA -30 dBm. Optical Return Loss Rrx min 12 dB (1G receiver table); Receiver Reflectance -12 dB (10G). POFF avg launch when off max -30 dBm. Duplex LC connector.
